Name: Transmute Quality
Author: DarcDio
Description:
Allows the user to upgrade/downgrade the quality of the item currently being held.


[size=4]Install Instructions[/size]:
1. Download SMAPI from either [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI Website[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI Nexus Mods Page[/url]
2. Unzip the [b]TransmuteQuality zipped file[/b] and move the [b]TransmuteQuality[/b] folder to your [b]Stardew Valley mods folder[/b].
3. Load the game and Hold an item that can have different qualities. Then press NumPad6. (Can be changed by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] or editing the config.json file)

[size=3]How to use[/size]:

Have your character hold an item that can have multiple qualities. Press the transmute button (Default: NumPad6), and a menu will pop up. Choose your option from the menu. The menu will show you either what you will make or what you'll have to pay to get the downgrade/upgrade done.

[size=4]Optional[/size]:

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url] installed, you can change the settings through that. If not then you can manually change them by editing the config.json file and reloading the game.

[size=3]Settings[/size]:
[b]ModEnabled[/b]  = [i]true or false. Determines if the mod should be enabled[/i].
[b]ActivationKey[/b]  = [i]SButton, the hotkey to activate the mod[/i].
[b]AllowQualityUpgrade[/b] = [i]true or false, whether or not the user should  be allowed to upgrade items[/i].

Credits:

I got the original idea for the mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12469]Sell Quality Mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/10630925]jasonmbrady[/url], but it hasn't been updated in two years.
